definitions.gloss: musical accompaniment in traditional performing arts
definitions.explanation: The instrumental ensemble or musical accompaniment used in traditional Japanese performing arts such as Noh, Kabuki, and festival performances. Typically features flute and drums.

examples.japanese: {囃子|はやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音|ね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of the musical accompaniment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{囃子|はやし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす→役割を果たす：19503_yakuwariwohatasu⟧。
examples.english: In Noh performances, the musical accompaniment plays an important role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{囃子|はやし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}き→響く：00099_hibiku⟧⟦{渡|わた}り→渡る：02441_wataru⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駆|か}け{寄|よ}って→駆け寄る：14681_kakeyoru⟧きた。
examples.english: The festival music echoed through the streets, and children came running over.

notes:
USAGE: {囃子|はやし} refers specifically to the instrumental ensemble in traditional Japanese performing arts. It is not used for Western-style musical accompaniment, which would be ⟦{伴奏|ばんそう}→伴奏：06566_bansou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {囃子|はやし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音|ね} (sound of the accompaniment)
- {祭|まつ}り{囃子|ばやし} (festival music) — note the voicing: はやし → ばやし
- ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧{囃子|ばやし} (Noh accompaniment)
- {囃子方|はやしかた} (musicians in the ensemble)

The standard Noh {囃子|はやし} ensemble consists of four instruments: ⟦{笛|ふえ}→笛：03593_fue⟧ (flute), {小鼓|こつづみ} (small hand drum), {大鼓|おおつづみ} (large hand drum), and ⟦{太鼓|たいこ}→太鼓：04049_taiko⟧ (stick drum). In compounds, the reading often voices to ばやし (rendaku).
